scope: Bounded source admission for a first diameter-and-depth census, with no review of enclosure engineering.

sources.title: LUC-GRAS200: A Global Lunar Crater Catalog at Sub-Kilometer Scale–Construction, Validation and Spatial Characteristics
sources.read: Publisher abstract, plain-language summary and data-availability statement; official README and downloaded CSV header and initial records. Full paper methods have not been read.
sources.use: Positions, diameter, positive rim-to-floor depth, detection confidence and resolution flags in the 200–1000 m band.
sources.limits: Published automated detections and DEM-derived relief; quality classes carry source uncertainty. The downloaded full CSV contains twelve fields, while its README also lists three scores/labels absent from this release. Only fields present in the CSV are used; the secondary flag is retained without filtering.

sources.title: An Improved Global Catalog of Lunar Impact Craters (≥1 km) With 3D Morphometric Information and Updates on Global Crater Analysis
sources.read: Publisher description and repository metadata in the preceding planning discussion.
sources.limits: The released catalogue starts at 1 km and supplies essentially no coverage within the adopted 500–1000 m range; it is not the census input.

sources.title: From the Moon to Mercury: Release of Global Crater Catalogs Using Multimodal Deep Learning for Crater Detection and Morphometric Analysis
sources.read: Depth-extraction equations and data-availability statement; Figshare version-1 file metadata and licence.
sources.use: An available alternative covering small craters with depth estimates.
sources.limits: Its 673 MB archive was not downloaded. The selected LUC-GRAS200 release covers the full requested 200–1000 m range with explicit depth and quality fields.

sources.title: Supplied discussion of vacuum-era pressure enclosures
sources.use: Motivates separate 200–300 m and 300–500 m comparison bands.
sources.limits: Engineering proposals and source claims awaiting their own review; pressure, material allowable, shielding and roof spans are outside this census.
